description:
Implement deterministic parent-nudge selection. Nudges are instruction **intents** (strings). They must not close tickets, spawn work, or parse child JSON.

## Background

`taskType` asks the parent a constrained question when a child changes state. Role is how the child worked. A native pass tried to enforce structured child results instead. Rejected.

## Files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/task-types.ts` (policy strings)
- tests

## Precedence (exact)

1. If `taskType` is present → that policy for the **event class**.
2. Else if event is `settled` or `failed` and role `completion_nudge` is present → that string.
3. Else generic for that event class.

Do not concatenate role guidance onto task-type guidance. `parentMessage` and `aborted` never use role completion_nudge.

## Intent matrix (lock the questions, not a frozen sentence protocol)

Event classes: `settled | aborted | failed | parentMessage`.

| Task type | settled | failed | aborted | parentMessage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| implementation | Assess evidence. Apply active domain review policy if any. Accept, dispatch a fix, or ask the user. Do not close a ticket solely because the child settled. | Inspect failure; retry/fix/escalate. | Do not retry unless the user asks. | Child still running. Answer via parent→child message or halt. Not settlement. |
| fix | Verify against the original finding. Independent re-review before acceptance. | Inspect failure; retry or escalate. | Same abort rule. | Same live-child rule. |
| reviewImplementation | Disposition every finding as **fix** (blocking, remediate + re-review), **file** (nonblocking follow-up unless the user waives a blocker in an ordinary turn), or **reject** (record why). Unresolved required fixes block acceptance. Judgment is the parent’s, not a keyword classifier. | Inspect failure; re-review or escalate. | Same abort rule. | Same live-child rule. |
| reviewScope | Adjudicate cross-ticket findings; judge whether the goal meets acceptance. | Inspect failure; re-review or escalate. | Same abort rule. | Same live-child rule. |
| investigateBlocker | Apply the answer to blocked work, or record why escalation remains. Investigation settlement is not implementation settlement. | Inspect failure; retry or escalate. | Same abort rule. | Same live-child rule. |
| (none) | Role fallback or “A background task settled. Inspect and decide.” | “A background task failed…” | “A background task was aborted. Do not retry unless the user asks.” | “A running child sent a question. Answer or halt; it has not settled.” |

Wording may be edited for clarity; the **questions and constraints** above must remain. Do not turn this into a required child result schema.

Coalesced packets call `nudgeFor(child, event)` per changed child.

## Success criteria

- `fix` vs `reviewImplementation` settled strings differ regardless of role.
- parentMessage never says settled.
- aborted is not failed copy.
- No concatenation.

## Test plan

- Full TaskType × NudgeEvent table; log each pair.
- taskType present ignores role nudge.
- Missing taskType + role nudge on settled; ignored on parentMessage/aborted.

## Considerations

Minions must not import beadwork. Implementation settled nudge may say “apply active domain review policy if any.”
title: Implement task-type nudge table and precedence
